about: Exchanges. A session is new, authenticated as device "d1" of app "todo", or a link session (authenticated as the server-kind device "s1", with no app). With the backend in the state given, a client call sends the client frame (and clientBody, if any); the server answers with the server frames (and serverBody); the call resolves with result or fails with the error code. push is a changed frame the server sends unasked, with that revision; pushDiverged is a diverged frame and pushResolved a resolved frame the server sends unasked; pushApps is an apps frame and pushDevices a devices frame (with pushRemoved as its removed) the server sends unasked; pushTakeOver is a takeOver frame the server sends unasked; pushResolve is a resolve frame the server sends unasked to a link session.
closes: the server closes the channel after its frames. An error frame also carries a message, English text for a developer whose wording is the server's; it is not compared.

Bodies are UTF-8 text. A body follows the frame that announces it: a put's body is its bytes past its offset, a doc's body the document's bytes past the offset it names. backend keys: welcome, helloError, paired, pairError, head (a revision), list ({revision, docs, removed}: the whole set), listError, doc ({path, id, type, etag, body}: the document the server holds), stale (the revision a stale answer names), getError, began (what a begin returns to), beginError, putError, deleteError, committed ({revision, docs}), conflict ({revision, docs}), commitError, abortError, resolveError, apps, appsError, devices, removed, announceError, invite ({code, expiresAt}), inviteError, term ({term, main}), termError. pageSize, when given, is the most entries the server puts in one list page in that exchange: a server pages by at most 500, and a client counts on no size.

Results: head and changed resolve with the revision; list with the page ({revision, docs, removed, cursor?}) and get with the document ({path, id, type, etag, bytes, offset, body}), or either with {stale: revision} when the server answers stale; begin with {tx, staged}; put and delete with {path, id, type, received}; commit with {committed: true, revision, docs}, or {committed: false, revision, docs} on a conflict; abort with {tx}; resolve with {server}; diverged with its servers and resolved with its server. A diverged a subordinate sends on its link session is not answered: the call resolves with null once it is sent, and a resolve pushed to a link session is heard as {app, keep, since}. A cursor is opaque: a client sends back the one it got, with the revision of the page that named it. A welcome result holds role, term, subordinates and diverged when the frame carries them. A registry result is the list of devices, or {devices, removed} when the frame carries removed.

exchanges are spoken by every client. serverKind holds the exchanges of a server-kind device: a subordinate server linking to its main. The client package does not speak them; the server's Session and its Go client play them.
tolerated: frames one side accepts although the other side never sends them.
